DiskRenewal.action: For this API, the parameter value is: purchaseReserved
DiskRenewal.clientToken: Idempotency token, an ASCII string of no more than 64 characters. See [ClientToken Idempotency](BCC/API Reference/General Description.md#idempotency) for details.
DiskRenewal.billing: Custom renewal duration, in months. If empty, it aligns with the expiration time of the attached BCC. The custom duration must be greater than (BCC expiration time - CDS current expiration time), otherwise the renewal fails. Supported duration is [1, 60] months.
DiskRenewal.billing.paymentTiming: Payment method, including Prepaid, Postpaid, and bidding instance (bidding)
DiskRenewal.billing.reservation: Reservation information. Not required for Postpaid; must be set for Prepaid.
DiskRenewal.instanceId: The prepaid BCC instance ID that the unattached disk is expected to be attached to. Required when the disk is unattached; optional or set to the current attached instance ID when already attached.
